answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure each node represents a unique entity. By mandating a heartbeat pulse of verified biometric data, the system creates a digital tundra where low-cost, automated identity generation becomes prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale fake accounts must bypass biometric entropy at the dawn of every session, forcing the adversary to expend real-world capital equivalent to the network's total staked value per identity.
